**Daily Devotional**

**April 13**

*10 But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation. (Jeremiah 10:10 KJV)*

This verse is contained in the book of Jeremiah, when he was speaking of idols. How anyone could worship an idol that cannot hear or see, or do anything at all, is amazing. If man makes an image of something and then worships it, no matter how pretty it is, it is just stupid (Leviticus 19:4). We may not be guilty of worshiping statues and images like in the Old Testament of the Bible, but we still worship idols of our own making. Whether it is money or other things like cars, homes, electronic gadgets, etc., we still manage to do our idol worship. As the book of Jeremiah points out, all those man made things will pass away when the living God’s wrath is poured out on this world (Revelation 16).

The only lasting things are those that are spiritual. When we put our efforts into living for the Lord and our fellow man, we are sowing spiritual seeds that will follow us into Heaven some day (Luke 12:34). Every time we give to the poor, help the needy, be kind to the elderly or widows, share the Gospel with others, and such things, then we are planting seeds for a future harvest. Jesus said, when we do these things, it is the same as doing it to Him (Matthew 25:40).

Needless to say, that all the idols in the world will not stand against the wrath of the Lord when He pours out his judgment upon the earth and all that is in it, including the unsaved people. Peter has said that everything will be burned up in the end (2 Peter 3:12), so store your treasure in heaven. Thank you Lord.
